children: New variants bring added safety, connectivity and convenience features across the premium motorcycle portfolio

TVS Motor Company has updated its Apache and Ronin motorcycle ranges ahead of the festive season, adding new variants and features across the portfolio. The updated motorcycles are available at TVS dealerships across India from 17 September.

The changes include new versions of the Apache RTR 160, RTR 160 4V and RTR 200 4V, along with Black Diamond Editions of the Apache RR 310 and RTR 310. The Ronin also gets a new Base+ variant, while its Mid and Top variants receive additional features.
The Apache RTR 160 now gets dual-channel anti-lock braking system (ABS), traction control system (TCS), hazard lamps and LED tail-stop lamps. The new variant is priced at Rs 1.28 lakh.

The RTR 160 4V gets a TFT display with Google Maps mirroring, Panic Brake Alert and a Type-C charging port. It is priced at Rs 1.41 lakh. The RTR 200 4V also gets the TFT display, Google Maps mirroring, Panic Brake Alert and Type-C charging, along with adjustable upside-down (USD) front suspension. It is priced at Rs 1.50 lakh.

The Apache RR 310 and RTR 310 are now available in Black Diamond Editions with an all-black finish. Both are based on their top variants with quickshifters. The RR 310 additionally gets Keyless Ride, which was already available on the RTR 310.

The RR 310 Black Diamond Edition is priced at Rs 2.88 lakh, while the RTR 310 Black Diamond Edition costs Rs 2.49 lakh, ex-showroom Delhi. Both continue with features such as cruise control, cornering ABS, cornering TCS, launch control and Drag Torque Control.
TVS has added a new Base+ variant to the Ronin range at Rs 1.42 lakh. It gets dual-channel ABS and is available in Sunlit Yellow and Desert Mirage.

The Mid variant, priced at Rs 1.52 lakh, now gets a connected instrument cluster and Type-C charger. The Top variant gets TCS, a Type-C charger and a premium seat, with prices starting at Rs 1.64 lakh.
The updated Apache and Ronin motorcycles are available across TVS dealerships from 17 September.
